steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In June 2024, a guest on Equity Mates described Imdex as a global leader in mining technology specialising in downhole navigation, with solutions that helped miners get rocks out faster and understand the orebody, especially as deposits became deeper and lower grade.
